title: Tensors 📦

answer.content: A **Tensor** is a multi-dimensional array similar to a NumPy array, but with the added ability to run on GPUs and support for automatic differentiation.

explanation: Tensors are the fundamental data structures used in TensorFlow.

title: Model Evaluation 📊
ques: Evaluate a compiled Keras model on test data `X_test` and `y_test`.
explanation: **`evaluate()`** computes the loss and metrics defined during compilation on the provided data.

title: Sequential API 🧱
ques: Create a simple Neural Network with one hidden layer of 10 neurons (ReLU) and an output layer of 1 neuron (Sigmoid).

answer.content:
model = tf.keras.models.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(10, activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')
])

explanation: The **Sequential API** allows you to build models layer-by-layer.
